items.headline: Wind Advisory issued November 13 at 12:14PM AKST until November 15 at 6:00AM AKST by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...East winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 45 mph expected.

* WHERE...Prince of Wales Island.

* WHEN...From 6 PM Saturday to 6 AM AKST Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Winds will begin to increase during the day
Saturday, reaching at least 45 mph during the evening timeframe.
Forecast confidence is increasing strong wind gusts will then
continue into Sunday.
items.instruction: Winds this strong can make travel difficult. Use extra caution.

items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued November 13 at 5:24AM AKST by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
Moderate snow and winds are expected along the Central Brooks
Range from from early Saturday morning through Saturday night.
Total snow accumulations could range between 2 and 5 inches during
this time frame. Localized gusty winds could produce areas of
blowing and drifting snow alongside reduced visibility especially
along Dalton Highway Summits. Travel may become difficult
throughout this period.
